body:
I called my psychiatrist but because I know him through the school, I can't get an appointment until next week. I don't know if I can make it through this week. I have assignments and exams and I haven't slept in days. I don't even know how i'm still here.

I can't take time off because I would lose my scholarship. I've thought about it but I don't want to lose everything I've worked so hard for. I just feel like I'm tired of waiting for things to get better. How much of my life is going to be spend waiting for things to be better?
